content.text: {"route":"gap","reason":"Material evidence is missing. The Threat Assessment Committee report and witness memos were never obtained: CAPT pointed to HR, HRM pointed to the Acting HRM, and the Acting HRM was never interviewed. LT2's photographs of Complainant's neck were not collected or addressed. CO1's contemporaneous memo is mentioned, but nothing shows it is in the record. The CAPT, who allegedly told police Complainant was 'psychologically unstable,' was not questioned on that point, and the police were not contacted. Comparator evidence on AWOL coding, welfare checks and medical requests is absent, and the record does not show whether CAPT knew of the EEO activity. The Claim 1 finding rests on the lack of an early report of the slurs, though CAPT recalled slurs in the committee report, which is inconsistent and unexamined. CO1 and CO2 flatly contradict Complainant, and no neutral evidence resolves that conflict."}
